raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A freed KV page keeps the previous request's KV until something overwrites it. If a bug ever lets a request read a page it does not own (a stale index, a transfer into the wrong pages), it reads another request's KV. This adds an opt-in flag that zeroes pages when they are freed, so such a bug reads zeros instead.

## Modifications

- New flag `SGLANG_ENABLE_ZERO_KV_ON_FREE` (off by default).
- On CUDA with page size > 1, every free path in `PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator` (`free`, `free_segment`, `free_page_ids`, `free_group_end`) ends in `_release_page_ids`. This PR hooks in there. `clear()` zeroes the whole pool.
- `KVPageZeroer` (`mem_cache/kv_page_zeroer.py`) zeroes every page-indexed buffer in a single Triton launch, using a table of buffer pointers (`zero_pages_multi` in `kernels/ops/kvcache/zero_pages.py`). It covers the target pool's KV, the DSA index-K buffers, and the draft model pools, which share the target allocator's page ids. Only `MLATokenToKVPool` and `DSATokenToKVPool` are supported for now. Any other pool or allocator raises an error at startup.
- Timing:
  - The zero runs on a side stream that first waits for the current stream and the forward stream. With overlap scheduling, the forward pass that is already running can still write the last token of a request whose pages are being freed, so zeroing at free time would miss that write.
  - Freed pages sit in a `zeroing_pages` list together with a CUDA event. They move to the free list only after the event has completed. Allocations check this without blocking, and only wait when the free list runs short.
  - Zeroing later (for example, just before the next forward pass) would be unsafe. The page could already have been handed to a writer that does not run on the forward stream, such as a PD KV transfer or a HiCache load, and the late zero would wipe its data.
- `available_size()` and `get_all_free_pages()` count pages that are still being zeroed, so the scheduler's capacity math does not change.

## Accuracy Tests

No change when the flag is off. With the flag on, only freed pages are touched.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not measured yet. Estimate: zero traffic roughly equals KV write traffic, plus one extra kernel launch and one event per free call.

## Tests

- `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_paged_allocator_zero_on_free.py` (CPU): freed pages are zeroed, kept pages are untouched, enabling the flag zeroes the pool, and pages stay out of the free list until their event completes (blocking only when the free list is short).
- `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_kv_page_zeroer_cuda.py` (CUDA): the fused kernel matches a torch reference across MLA-like and index-K-like buffers, and the zero is ordered after pending forward-stream writes.

Draft: the CPU tests pass locally, but the CUDA test and an end-to-end run have not been run on a GPU yet.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+
+@triton.jit
+def _zero_pages_multi_kernel(
+    buf_ptrs,  # int64 [B] base address of each page-major buffer
+    buf_page_words,  # int64 [B] int64 words per page in each buffer
+    pages_ptr,  # int64 [M] page ids to zero
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    m = tl.program_id(0)
+    b = tl.program_id(1)
+    blk = tl.program_id(2)
+    page_words = tl.load(buf_page_words + b)
+    if blk * BLOCK >= page_words:
+        return
+    base = tl.load(buf_ptrs + b).to(tl.pointer_type(tl.int64))
+    pg = tl.load(pages_ptr + m).to(tl.int64)
+    offs = blk * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = offs < page_words
+    tl.store(base + pg * page_words + offs, 0, mask=mask)
+
+
+def zero_pages_multi(
+    buf_ptrs: torch.Tensor,
+    buf_page_words: torch.Tensor,
+    max_page_words: int,
+    pages: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """Zero the listed pages in every page-major buffer with one launch."""
+    m = int(pages.numel())
+    if m == 0:
+        return
+    grid = (m, int(buf_ptrs.numel()), triton.cdiv(max_page_words, _BLOCK))
+    _zero_pages_multi_kernel[grid](
+        buf_ptrs, buf_page_words, pages.to(torch.int64), BLOCK=_BLOCK
+    )

+"""Zero freed KV pages before the allocator hands them out again."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional, Sequence
+
+import torch
+
+
+def kv_page_buffers(pool) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+    """Every page-indexed buffer of ``pool`` as a uint8 [rows, page_bytes] view,
+    where row ``p`` holds page ``p``."""
+    from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import DSATokenToKVPool, MLATokenToKVPool
+
+    if type(pool) not in (MLATokenToKVPool, DSATokenToKVPool):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Zeroing KV pages on free does not support {type(pool).__name__}"
+        )
+    buffers = [
+        buf.view(torch.uint8).view(-1, pool.page_size * buf[0].nbytes)
+        for buf in pool.kv_buffer
+    ]
+    if type(pool) is DSATokenToKVPool:
+        buffers += [
+            buf.view(torch.uint8).view(buf.shape[0], -1)
+            for buf in pool.index_key_cache.buffer
+            if buf.shape[0] > 0
+        ]
+    return buffers
+
+
+class KVPageZeroer:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        buffers: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+        wait_streams: Sequence[torch.cuda.Stream] = (),
+    ):
+        assert buffers, "no KV buffers to zero"
+        self.buffers = list(buffers)
+        self.num_rows = min(b.shape[0] for b in self.buffers)
+        self.device = self.buffers[0].device
+        self.is_cuda = self.device.type == "cuda"
+        self.wait_streams = list(wait_streams)
+        if not self.is_cuda:
+            return
+
+        page_bytes = [b.shape[1] for b in self.buffers]
+        assert all(n % 8 == 0 for n in page_bytes), page_bytes
+        self.buf_ptrs = torch.tensor(
+            [b.data_ptr() for b in self.buffers], dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device
+        )
+        self.buf_page_words = torch.tensor(
+            [n // 8 for n in page_bytes], dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device
+        )
+        self.max_page_words = max(page_bytes) // 8
+        self.stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=self.device)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_pools(cls, pools, wait_streams=()) -> KVPageZeroer:
+        unique = {id(p): p for p in pools if p is not None}
+        buffers = [b for p in unique.values() for b in kv_page_buffers(p)]
+        return cls(buffers, wait_streams)
+
+    def zero(self, page_ids: torch.Tensor) -> Optional[torch.cuda.Event]:
+        """Queue zeroing of ``page_ids``. The pages may be reused once the
+        returned event completes (None means already done)."""
+        if not self.is_cuda:
+            for buf in self.buffers:
+                buf[page_ids] = 0
+            return None
+
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.kvcache.zero_pages import zero_pages_multi
+
+        # Wait for in-flight forwards: an overlapped forward may still write the
+        # last token of a request whose pages are being freed.
+        self.stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device))
+        for stream in self.wait_streams:
+            self.stream.wait_stream(stream)
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self.stream):
+            zero_pages_multi(
+                self.buf_ptrs, self.buf_page_words, self.max_page_words, page_ids
+            )
+        page_ids.record_stream(self.stream)
+        event = torch.cuda.Event()
+        event.record(self.stream)
+        return event

+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "needs CUDA")
+class TestKVPageZeroerCuda(CustomTestCase):

+        kv = [

+"""PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator zeroes freed pages before handing them out again."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.allocator.paged import PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv_page_zeroer import KVPageZeroer
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=8, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+PAGE_SIZE = 2
+NUM_PAGES = 8
+
+
+def _buffers():
+    # Row 0 is the padded dummy page, as in the real pools.
+    return [
+        torch.ones((NUM_PAGES + 1, 16), dtype=torch.uint8),
+        torch.ones((NUM_PAGES + 1, 8), dtype=torch.uint8),
+    ]
+
+
+def _allocator(zeroer, *, need_sort=False) -> PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator:
+    allocator = PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator(
+        size=NUM_PAGES * PAGE_SIZE,
+        page_size=PAGE_SIZE,
+        dtype=torch.float16,
+        device="cpu",
+        kvcache=None,
+        need_sort=need_sort,
+    )
+    allocator.enable_zero_on_free(zeroer)
+    return allocator
+
+
+def _page_ids(indices: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return indices[::PAGE_SIZE] // PAGE_SIZE
+
+
+class _Event:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.done = False
+        self.waited = False
+
+    def query(self):
+        return self.done
+
+    def synchronize(self):
+        self.waited = True
+        self.done = True
+
+
+class _PendingZeroer:
+    num_rows = NUM_PAGES + 1
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.events = []
+
+    def zero(self, page_ids):
+        self.events.append(_Event())
+        return self.events[-1]
+
+
+class TestPagedAllocatorZeroOnFree(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_enable_zeroes_every_page(self):
+        buffers = _buffers()
+        _allocator(KVPageZeroer(buffers))
+        for buf in buffers:
+            self.assertEqual(int(buf[1:].sum()), 0)
+            self.assertTrue(torch.all(buf[0] == 1))
+
+    def test_free_zeroes_only_freed_pages(self):
+        for need_sort in (False, True):
+            buffers = _buffers()
+            allocator = _allocator(KVPageZeroer(buffers), need_sort=need_sort)
+            indices = allocator.alloc(4 * PAGE_SIZE)
+            for buf in buffers:
+                buf.fill_(7)
+
+            allocator.free(indices[: 2 * PAGE_SIZE])
+            freed = _page_ids(indices[: 2 * PAGE_SIZE])
+            kept = _page_ids(indices[2 * PAGE_SIZE :])
+            for buf in buffers:
+                self.assertEqual(int(buf[freed].sum()), 0)
+                self.assertTrue(torch.all(buf[kept] == 7))
+            self.assertEqual(allocator.available_size(), 6 * PAGE_SIZE)
+
+            reused = allocator.alloc(6 * PAGE_SIZE)
+            self.assertEqual(
+                set(_page_ids(reused).tolist()),
+                set(range(1, NUM_PAGES + 1)) - set(kept.tolist()),
+            )
+
+    def test_pages_wait_for_zeroing(self):
+        zeroer = _PendingZeroer()
+        allocator = _allocator(zeroer)
+        zeroer.events[0].done = True
+        indices = allocator.alloc(4 * PAGE_SIZE)
+        allocator.free(indices)
+        pending = zeroer.events[-1]
+        self.assertEqual(allocator.available_size(), NUM_PAGES * PAGE_SIZE)
+        self.assertEqual(len(allocator.get_all_free_pages()), NUM_PAGES)
+
+        # Never-freed pages are enough: the freed ones stay in quarantine.
+        first = allocator.alloc(4 * PAGE_SIZE)
+        self.assertFalse(pending.waited)
+        self.assertTrue(
+            set(_page_ids(first).tolist()).isdisjoint(_page_ids(indices).tolist())
+        )
+
+        # Allocating beyond that waits for the zeroing to finish.
+        second = allocator.alloc(4 * PAGE_SIZE)
+        self.assertTrue(pending.waited)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            set(_page_ids(second).tolist()), set(_page_ids(indices).tolist())
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(allocator.num_zeroing_pages, 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
